suggestions.pitch: I am 3-6 with a 0.05 window, so I should sell 37-year-old Travis Kelce and DK Metcalf to the 7-2 contender for Brock Bowers, a 23-year-old elite TE.
Kelce is scoring 17.6 a week at age 37 and will lose value, so sell him to a contender for the younger Kyle Pitts.
Selling 33-year-old DeAndre Hopkins and Rhamondre Stevenson to a 6-3 contender for 25-year-old Jameson Williams converts aging value into a younger asset.
